change_from_v6: After 0/8 canonical-L10 proposals, enlarge the preregistered small-scale ensemble to 32 without changing any physical gate. N576 is now the explicit canonical long-mode source and PM mesh. It is not a RAMSES level: a promoted source is Fourier-projected to the L9 base, interpolated into L10--L12, and supplemented only above the N576 Nyquist frequency.

screen.canonical_projection: identity on the N576 PM mesh; promoted physical modes are projected/interpolated, never redrawn
